'''Mandallia''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Mandalore system/Legends|Mandalore system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Mandallian Giant]]s, a [[Species/Legends|race]] of physically large and muscular beings raised from birth as [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]], Mandallia was the neighbor world of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian's]] home planet, [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]. The two worlds became associated after a failed invasion by the ancient [[Mandalorian Crusaders]] displayed the prowess of Mandallia's inhabitants, earning the Mandallian Giants the respect of the Mandalorians. Mandallia became a part of [[Mandalore sector/Legends|Mandalorian space]] following the Mandalorians' conquest of expansion during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], with many Mandallians having earned the right to join the Mandalorians and fight alongside the original [[Taung/Legends|Taung]] race.

==Description==
Mandallia was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]' [[Mandalore sector/Legends|Mandalore sector]]. Located within the [[Mandalore system/Legends|Mandalore system]], Mandallia occupied the sixth [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] around the [[Star system/Legends|system's]] [[Star/Legends|star]], [[Mandalore (star)/Legends|Mandalore]], between the orbits of the planets [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] and [[Bonagal]]. A terrestrial world circled by a single [[Moon/Legends|moon]],<ref name="TEA" /> Mandallia gave rise<ref name="HotM" /> to a [[Species/Legends|race]] of immense, muscular beings covered in [[Color/Legends|green]]<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> or blue scales, known as [[Mandallian Giant]]s.<ref name="HotM" />

==History==
When the [[Taung/Legends|Taung]] warriors recast themselves as [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]], and set out to conquer the worlds that surrounded their newly subjugated [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of Mandalore, these [[Mandalorian Crusaders]] set their sights on the neighboring Mandallia. However, the native Mandallian Giants<ref name="HotM" /> were trained in several forms of combat from infancy, developing powerful martial skills,<ref name="TCSWE" /> and when the Mandalorian Crusaders descended upon Mandallia, they were soundly repelled by its inhabitants. Such was the prowess of the Mandallians, that they earned the respect of their would-be conquerors, and were among the first to fight alongside the original Taung race as Mandalorians.<ref name="HotM" />
